note: Project style for locally generated reference art (forge `concept`, PRD-3, PRD-7, 2026-11-02). styleBlock is appended to every template prompt so all assets share one look; anchors are director-approved concept images passed as reference images (1-3 per call) once the golden-sample bake-off has produced them.
